title: The Black Whale

timeline.event: Departure of the Black Whale from the port of Kakin
Beyond Netero is imprisoned in Tier 1 VVIP prison
Kurapika and Leorio join the Zodiacs on board

keyEvents: Introduction to the Black Whale and its mission
Beyond Netero is already detained
Kurapika and Leorio join the Zodiacs team
description: Introductory chapter presenting the Black Whale ship, its 6-tier structure, and the main players in the arc. The ship leaves the port of Kakin with on board the 14 princes, their factions, and the Zodiacs responsible for monitoring Beyond Netero.

title: The Mission

timeline.event: Meeting of the princes on Tier 1 - Official announcement of the War of Succession
Explanation of the rules: the Urn of the Seed will choose the successor
The factions begin to organize themselves in their respective chambers

keyEvents: Announcement of the War of Succession by King Nasubi
Presentation of the 14 princes and their initial strategies
Distribution of rooms in Tiers 1 and 2
description: King Nasubi Hui Guo Rou officially announces the start of the War of Succession. The 14 princes (and Princess Woble) divide up into their respective districts on Tiers 1 and 2. Each prince begins to implement his strategy to survive and be chosen by the Urn of the Seed.

title: Departure

timeline.event: The Black Whale leaves the port of Kakin for the New Continent
Woody is found exsanguinated on the bathroom floor of room 1014
The inaugural banquet gathers the royal family
Kacho proposes an alliance to Fugetsu during the banquet
Four more bodyguards are found drained of blood in a corridor

keyEvents: The Black Whale sails and the Succession Contest opens
Woody is the first of the five drained guards
The inaugural banquet seats the fourteen princes
Kurapika reads the five deaths as parasitic Nen
description: The ship sails at noon on a two-month crossing — three weeks of charted water, then five of open passage — while the Zodiacs prepare to break off for the Gate. Within half an hour Woody dies exsanguinated in room 1014, and four more guards are found the same way after the inaugural banquet. Five deaths in an afternoon is what tells Kurapika the contest has already started.

title: Nen Beasts

timeline.event: Benjamin posts his private soldiers in every prince's quarters, on Balsamilco's counsel
Rihan is transferred from Benjamin to Sale-sale then to Tubeppa
Tubeppa (5th Princess) transforms her room 1005 into a laboratory

keyEvents: Camilla asks the king to confirm that only biological death drops a prince from the contest
Balsamilco tells Benjamin every prince carries a beast he cannot see
Benjamin posts his soldiers in the princes' quarters
Vincent stabs a servant in room 1014
Transfert de Rihan entre factions
Tubeppa etablit son laboratoire
description: The princes take the measure of their Guardian Spirit Beasts. Zhang Lei reads the massacre of Woble's detail as the key to them, Camilla presses the king on the rules, and Benjamin — who cannot see his own beast — posts his private soldiers in every prince's quarters, which is how Vincent walks into room 1014. The two later entries below, Rihan's transfers and Tubeppa's laboratory, belong to chapters this catalogue has not separated out yet.

title: Foul Play

timeline.event: Oito watches room 1012 through Little Eye as Momoze is strangled
Momoze is assassinated in her own room
Hanzo and Biscuit read the killing as the work of an off-duty guard
Emperor Time collapses Kurapika after nearly three hours
Tserriednich asks Theta how long learning Nen takes

keyEvents: Momoze is the first prince killed aboard
Kurapika loses about 450 days of life to Emperor Time
The princes agree to send two guards each to the Nen class
Tserriednich turns on Theta
description: Oito's Little Eye reaches room 1012 in time to watch Momoze suffocate and too late to stop it. The six guards on her door are detained, though Hanzo and Biscuit read the killing as the work of an off-duty guard operating a copy of himself. Kurapika, who has held Emperor Time for nearly three hours and paid some 450 days of his life for it, collapses after setting the first Nen lesson for the next day.

title: Limits

timeline.event: Eighteen hours have passed since the departure horn
Kurapika wakes after about nine hours unconscious, Oito having gone down with him
Continuous Emperor Time is capped at three hours, and going past it costs a black-out three times as long
The princes send sixteen guards and servants to the class, each with orders of their own
Kurapika sets the rules: a white line nobody crosses, force without warning, exclusion for anyone who breaks it
Silent Majority possesses Loberry during Kurapika's first Nen class
Asked who already knows Nen, only Furykov and Belerainte raise a hand

keyEvents: The chapter opens on the ship at sea, eighteen hours out of Kakin — the second day
A second caption puts the first Nen class at 09:00 on Day 2
Kurapika was out for about nine hours; the others were told he was on a mission
Emperor Time held past three hours costs a black-out of three times the time spent, and takes down whoever shares the ability
Each prince briefs his own envoys before the class, and the orders contradict one another — spy, recruit, learn, or kill
Exclusion from the class is the sanction that binds them, since none of them can afford to be sent back empty-handed
Loberry is the only witness to the masked doll watching the Nen class
Two of the sixteen admit to knowing Nen; the hidden assassin counts four more who say nothing
description: The opening panel puts the Black Whale alone on the water and dates it: second day, eighteen hours since departure — which sets the morning of Day 2, given the noon departure of chapter 340. Kurapika wakes there from about nine hours of black-out, the price of holding Emperor Time past its three-hour ceiling: the penalty is three times the time spent, and Oito, who shared the ability, went down at the same moment. Bill has covered for him by telling the others he was on a mission. A second caption, three hours later, dates the rest: second day, nine in the morning, the guards assembled for the first Nen class outside room 1014. The chapter then goes down the line of envoys prince by prince — the orders are to spy, to recruit, to learn on pain of death — before Kurapika draws his white line and asks who among them already knows Nen. Two hands go up. The doll is already in the room, and only Loberry can see it.

title: Observation

timeline.event: Loberry points at the masked doll nobody else can see and panics
Four tsuchibokko fasten onto Barrigen and drain him in front of the class
The class is left with a body it never saw attacked

keyEvents: Loberry, the only one the doll is visible to, is made to point at it in front of everyone
The guards see nothing but something white around Barrigen's neck and try to tear it off
One tsuchibokko needs 44 seconds to drain a body; the four together take barely 11
Barrigen dies among sixteen witnesses and a Nen teacher, none of whom can see the weapon
description: The murder happens in the open. The assassin's rule was stated a chapter earlier — only the user and the possessed Loberry can see the decorative doll — and this is what it is for: Loberry cries out at a girl in a strange mask that no one else can find, and while the room is looking for a witness's hallucination, four conjured tsuchibokko take Barrigen by the neck. The guards see a white thing they cannot pull off; a single doll would need 44 seconds to empty a body, four working together need about 11. The class Kurapika convened at 09:00 becomes an investigation before he has taught anything, and the ability's whole design is on display: a weapon invisible to every witness, operated through the one witness who can see it. Myuhan dies the same way, but a day later — chapter 376, not here.

title: Ability

timeline.event: A caption gives the elapsed time since the ship put to sea: 37 h 30 min
The Woble camp takes stock: Hanzo's disappearance is read as a defence by Marayam's Nen beast, and keeping a line to him open is called essential
Fugetsu wakes in her bed; the clock at her bedside reads TUESDAY 01:27 AM
Fugetsu's Magical Worm opens a passage between her room and Kacho's

keyEvents: The third time stamp of the voyage: 37 h 30 min out of port, so 01:30 on Day 3
A bedside clock reads TUESDAY 01:27 AM — the only weekday the arc ever shows, which makes the noon departure a Sunday
Hanzo, gone into Marayam's quarters, is treated as alive and reachable rather than dead
Fugetsu's beast turns out to open a passage rather than defend her, and its door is the entrance of the Magic Warm ride she played on with Kacho as a child
description: A caption over the water counts 37 h 30 min since departure — 01:30 of the third day against the noon sailing of chapter 340, the small hours after the class that cost Barrigen his life. The chapter spends them quietly: the galley works, Oito holds Woble, and the Woble camp sorts what it knows, reading Hanzo's disappearance inside Marayam's quarters as a defensive act of the thirteenth prince's beast and treating the line to him as the thing to keep open. Fugetsu, woken three minutes earlier by a clock reading TUESDAY 01:27 AM, watches a door rise out of her wall — the entrance of the Magic Warm ride she and Kacho played on as children — and it opens onto her sister's room. The clock and the caption agree to within three minutes, and the weekday is the one the arc never gives anywhere else: counted back, the Black Whale sailed at noon on a Sunday, which is what the banquet hall's Sunday schedule assumes.

title: Determination

timeline.event: A caption dates the session: third day, 10:05 in the morning
Camilla's camp pleads self-defence and demands Musse be handed over, charging Benjamin with ordering the killing
Benjamin's camp objects that ten rounds at an unarmed prince is disproportionate, and disowns Musse
Cleapatro confines both princes to the VIP zone under escort and has the Royal Army search every residence
Myuhan is attacked the moment he enters the toilets and is dry ten seconds later
Kurapika seals the salon and the bedroom and reads the killer's pattern: only people without Nen
The class demands the Royal Army be called and calls the Nen lesson a fabrication

keyEvents: The fourth time stamp of the voyage: third day, 10:05 in the morning
The contest is argued in a courtroom rather than settled by Nen — the ship has a jurisdiction and the princes use it
Both princes are confined to the VIP zone until Musse is caught, escorted by supervisors answering to the magistrate
One demanded search becomes a search of every residence on the deck
Benjamin's camp is unbothered: whatever Camilla does, wherever she goes, they will know
Myuhan dies in the toilets of room 1014, drained in about ten seconds
Three of the dolls are shot down and one is reported still inside; the killer's doll then vanishes, too big to have left by the pipes
The victims are always people without Nen, which makes Kurapika's presence the only shelter the class has
The envoys threaten to call the army, which would put the queen, the prince and the detail in separate detention
description: The morning after the night of 01:27, at 10:05, the attack of chapter 373 comes before Cleapatro. Camilla's counsel tells it as self-defence: her militia-borne attacker was Benjamin's man Musse, she saw a weapon on her and fired, then went after him and met two more armed men — Hyurikofu, of Benjamin's militia, and Vorufu, of the first queen's guard. Her side wants Musse surrendered for attempted murder and Benjamin charged with ordering it. His side calls ten rounds on an unarmed prince disproportionate and disowns Musse outright. What the court cannot know is that chapter 373 already showed the truth beneath both accounts: Musse killed Camilla, and the beast that survives her killed him and rebuilt her. The magistrate confines both princes to the VIP zone until Musse is found, leaves their protection details in place but attaches a court supervisor to every outing, and turns the two camps' demands for a search into a search of every residence on Tier 1. Benjamin's camp leaves unworried — detention keeps Camilla out of reach, and Secret Window means they will know what she does anyway. The same day, in room 1014, the killer takes Myuhan: attacked the instant he enters the toilets, screaming once and dry ten seconds later. Kurapika shuts the salon and has Bill hold the bedroom door, and states what the deaths have in common — the killer only takes people with no Nen, so nobody is at risk while he is in the room. The class does not hear a protection; it hears an extermination it was lured into, and demands the Royal Army. That is the one thing his camp cannot afford: with the court already ordering every residence searched, the army would separate Oito and Woble from their detail, and the guards have to be talked into staying for a lesson whose premise they no longer believe.

title: Mafia Wars

timeline.event: The Xi-Yu (Hinrigh) family operates on the lower thirds
The Cha-R family (Ken'i Wang) tactically allies with the Phantom Troupe
Hisoka negotiates with the Xi-Yu mafia

keyEvents: Activities of the Xi-Yu mafia
Alliance Cha-R / Brigade Fantome
Negociations Hisoka / Xi-Yu
description: Mafia factions become major players in the conflict. The Phantom Troupe allies with the Cha-R against Hisoka, while the latter negotiates with the Xi-Yu.

title: Heil-Ly's Gambit

timeline.event: Morena gathers the twenty-three surviving Heil-Ly in room 302 and infects them one by one
Morena Prudo activates 'Et tu, Juliet' on the ship
Luini uses his dimensional ability to pass through armored walls
Tserriednich uses the Heil-Ly to sow chaos

keyEvents: Room 302 is where the Heil-Ly become Nen users: twenty-three present, examined one at a time
Morena took the head of the clan by ordering its members to kill one another; those who stayed are the ones she thanks
She states her goal plainly — she cares nothing for this world or for herself, which is why she destroys it
Activation d'Et tu, Juliet par Morena
Luini crosses the armored structures
Tserriednich uses Heil-Lys as weapons
description: The Heil-Ly family deploys their Nen infection strategy. It starts in room 302 on Tier 3, where Morena thanks the twenty-three people who chose to stay with her after she ordered them to kill one another, and calls them forward one at a time to have their faculties examined — the kiss that carries Contagion. Morena Prudo activates her kill-rewarding ability, while Luini uses her dimensional powers to infiltrate secure areas.

title: Initiative

timeline.event: Hisoka arrives in Tier 5 and begins his hunt
The Phantom Troupe settles in Tier 5
Premieres tensions entre factions mafieuses (Xi-Yu, Cha-R, Heil-Ly)
Kurapika begins teaching Nen to Queen Oito and training Woble's guards

keyEvents: Arrival of Hisoka and start of his hunt by the Phantom Troupe
Installation of mafia factions on lower thirds
Kurapika begins his Nen teaching
Premieres alliances et tensions entre factions
description: Hisoka arrives on the Black Whale and immediately begins his hunt. The Phantom Troupe, with Chrollo and Nobunaga, settles in Tier 5 to organize the hunt. Meanwhile, Kurapika begins training Queen Oito and Prince Woble's guards in Nen, while monitoring the movements of the other factions.

title: Awakening

timeline.event: Halkenburg confronts Nasubi and fires on him
The king's Guardian Spirit Beast stops the bullet
Halkenburg looses his first arrow at Shikaku
Salé-salé is assassinated by Yushohi on Benjamin's order
Kurapika reads the second major aura disturbance of the voyage

keyEvents: Halkenburg enters the contest he had withdrawn from
The king's beast proves no participant can die before the ritual ends
Salé-salé is the second prince killed aboard
The Sunday banquet is set for 20:00 on the eighth day
description: Halkenburg waits four days for the audience, then puts a bullet toward his father — and the king's Guardian Spirit Beast takes it, proof that no participant dies before the ritual closes. Nasubi answers with the prisoner's trolley problem: a king weighs the nation, not his siblings. Halkenburg leaves the room a participant, and his first arrow, paid for with one of his own men, cannot be blocked once drawn. In room 1008 Yushohi kills Salé-salé on Benjamin's order.

title: Escape

timeline.event: Melody plays a three-minute flute solo that holds the banquet
Kacho and Fugetsu leave the ship by lifeboat
Hands close around the lifeboat and the twins turn back
Kacho dies on the drifting lifeboat and Without You takes her shape

location: Tier 1 - Banquet Hall / Black Whale 1 - lifeboat
keyEvents: Melody covers the escape from the banquet stage
Leaving the ship is shown to be a death sentence for a prince
Magical Worm and Without You are named
Kacho dies so Fugetsu can go on
description: Melody's solo holds the banquet for three minutes while Keeney puts the twins in a lifeboat. Hands rise around the boat and Kacho understands that a prince who runs only finds death; the sisters go back to their room and change the plan. Fugetsu's Magical Worm opens the tunnels out, Kacho's return leg brings them home — and Without You, formless, takes whichever twin dies. Kacho stays on the boat.

title: Parasite

timeline.event: Assassination of Momoze (12th Princess) in room 1012
Marayam (13th Prince) activates his Nen ability to isolate room 1013
Benjamin (1st Prince) imposes Martial Law from room 1001
Camilla (2nd Princess) attempts to murder Benjamin and is imprisoned
Tserriednich (4th Prince) manipulates the Heil-Ly to sow chaos
Kacho (10th Princess) and Fugetsu (11th Princess) try to escape with Melody
Hisoka assassinates two members of the Phantom Troupe in Tier 5
Kurapika uses Little Eye (cockroaches) to spy on other factions

keyEvents: Premier meurtre : Momoze assasinee
Marayam active sa protection Nen
Benjamin imposes Martial Law
Camilla emprisonnee
Hisoka kills two members of the Phantom Troupe
Tentative de fuite de Kacho et Fugetsu
Debut de l'espionnage massif de Kurapika
description: The war intensifies with the first killings and the first major strategies. Benjamin takes military control, Hisoka takes action, and Kurapika activates his spy network. Mafia factions begin to play an active role in the conflict, manipulating the princes and their guards.

title: Speculation

timeline.event: Kurapika models the cumulative conjuration in Zhang Lei's coins
Halkenburg forces a mind swap into Balsamilco's body
Benjamin prepares Halkenburg's funeral procession

keyEvents: Zhang Lei's coins are read as an ability handed out without training
Halkenburg is shown to swap minds by force
The second Nen class is set for Thursday morning
description: Kurapika works out that Zhang Lei's coins carry a cumulative conjuration: held long enough, they would give their owners working abilities with no training at all. In the other camp Halkenburg's power is revealed for what it is — a forced mind swap, already used on Balsamilco, with only one of the two minds awake at a time and priority to the side staking its life. He means to die in Balsamilco's body and keep the ten hours that follow.

title: Performance

timeline.event: The real Hisoka gambles at the Tier 1 casino
Bonolenov, wearing Hisoka, meets the real one
Bonolenov kills Lynch Fullbokko and works Zakuro upward through the tiers
The Spiders read the Heil-Ly as a faction out to destroy everything
Morena's people prepare to work Halkenburg's funeral

keyEvents: Hisoka returns to the page after chapter 357
Chrollo's decoy is revealed as Bonolenov
The Heil-Ly turn the funeral into a hunting ground
description: Hisoka is at a Tier 1 table when the man wearing his face walks in: Chrollo put Bonolenov in the disguise to keep the Mafia looking the wrong way while the Troupe works. Lower down, Nobunaga, Phinks and Feitan sit with the Cha-R and conclude the Heil-Ly are not after money but after ruin, paid for in lives. Morena's people, meanwhile, are getting ready for Halkenburg's funeral, where Dogman's nose can pick a Nen user out of a crowd.

title: Regalia

timeline.event: Halkenburg's first body dies
Tajao guides the Spiders through the lower decks
The Xi-Yu find Lynch Fullbokko with a broken neck
Chrollo names the three Kakin regalia as his target

keyEvents: The Heil-Ly hold the waste route between Tiers 4 and 5
Hinrigh reads the double deception around Hisoka's location
Chrollo is after the Seed Urn, the Lotus Anchorite and the Sword of Good Omens
description: Nobunaga learns that the Heil-Ly control the waste processing running between Tiers 4 and 5 — a way to move as contractors and take people off the ship one at a time. The Xi-Yu find Lynch dead, and Hinrigh reads the layered trick behind it: someone wearing Hisoka manipulated a woman already manipulated, so that Hisoka would be looked for where he is not. In the crowd at Halkenburg's funeral procession, Chrollo says what he came for — the three sacred treasures of Kakin, kept on Tier 1 and tied to the machinery of the contest.

title: Loyalty

timeline.event: Nasubi sees Halkenburg's flame unlit at the burial
Halkenburg works his ability from Balsamilco's body out of room 1009
Benjamin finds he carries TSK-17 and traces it back to his own mother
Furykov explains the mark under his tongue
Benjamin proclaims special martial law at 14:15

keyEvents: An unlit flame proves a soul without its body still holds succession rights
Benjamin's poisoning is traced to Unma through Furykov
Martial law puts every prince under summons to room 1001
description: Nasubi reads the unlit flame at the burial: Halkenburg's rights stand as long as his soul sits in a body, and it sits in Balsamilco's, working the marked followers out of room 1009. Benjamin, finding TSK-17 in his own blood, suspects Balsamilco and lands on his mother — Unma bought Halkenburg's victory by having Furykov infect him, holding the curse Beyond set under his tongue at birth over his head. At 14:15 Benjamin proclaims special martial law, orders the rival guards executed and summons the princes to room 1001.

title: Truth or Falsehood

timeline.event: Furykov confronts Beyond about his sacrificial curse
Kurapika and Oito prepare a message for the mainland
The royal camps respond to special martial law

timeline.location: Black Whale 1 - Tier 1 Royal Residential Sector

keyEvents: Furykov analyzes and confronts Beyond about his curse
Furykov's connection to Beyond
Conflicting orders reshape the royal camps

description: A flashback two months before departure shows Furykov analyzing the sacrificial curse placed on him at birth and confronting Beyond after the Seed Urn Ceremony assigns it a royal target. In the present, Kurapika and Oito prepare a message for the mainland before martial law spreads and Ridge halts Kanjidol's assault.
